summary: Replace the absolute floor in build_panels with the chosen rule at BOTH sites — the anchor gate and the partner filter — config-driven, ranking untouched, with fixture tests covering a mis-tagged anchor staying empty; needs 404da836

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content:
Owner decision (supersedes this ticket's own summary text and the open
investigation todo:404da836): the absolute score floor (config[scoring].min_grade,
-4.415) is removed from build_panels entirely, at both the anchor gate and the
partner filter. The thin scorer's score is used only to RANK partners within a
via concept; it never admits or excludes a (concept, chunk) pair. A pair with NO
score at all (scoring never ran for it) is still excluded -- that is a coverage
gap, not a low score, and stays distinct from "scored low."

Evidence (parent todo:7427712c, docs/summary/derived-parallels-cutover-2026-08-14.md):
- Of 27,395 human-VERIFIED (concept, chunk) pairs at node 11, only 18.9% cleared
  -4.415 -- the floor was discarding four-fifths of completed human review work.
- Unreviewed auto-promoted (tier='proposed') pairs cleared at 22.6%, slightly
  MORE permissive than human-verified pairs (18.9%) -- the score carries no
  signal about whether a chunk actually expresses a concept, only about
  cross-encoder logit magnitude.
- Clearance tracks passage length, not relevance: 12% for chunks under 500
  chars vs 58% for 2,000-2,400 chars, so one global cut penalizes verse/aphorism
  traditions against discursive prose.
- Simulated effect of removal over the existing score cache: chunks carrying a
  panel 2,364 -> 5,054; texts with any panel 166 -> 235.
- The score's RANKING remains correct where spot-checked (sunyata_emptiness
  tops Diamond Sutra, wu_wei tops Tao Te Ching, sephirot tops Lesser Holy
  Assembly) -- only the absolute cut is wrong, not the model.

Not addressed by this ticket: mis-tagged anchors (e.g. enuma-elish / cosmogony,
todo:743ba79b) are a tagging-accuracy problem, not a scoring-floor problem, and
are handled by fixing the tag, not by an absolute score cut. Panel size growth
from floor removal is bounded by the existing per_work_cap and by guru-web's
weight-ordered panel query (guru-web todo:bc084b37), not by an admission floor
here.

resolution.note: Removed min_grade at both build_panels sites (anchor gate + partner filter); anchor gate now requires only that (concept, chunk) has a score, partner filter drops only b is None (still a valid early-exit since build_ranked sorts unscored candidates to the end); dropped min_grade from build_panels signature, run(), and config/derived_parallels.toml; docs/ingest/16-derive-parallels.md Failure modes records the measured floor-was-wrong evidence. Full suite green (621 passed, 48 skipped, 1 xfailed).
